cellEncoding: rows is the lossless cell-record matrix. Null means no explicit XLSX cell. For numeric cells, value and rawValue retain the exact XLSX decimal text.
valueEncoding: values is the analysis-ready matrix over dataRange. Text stays text, blank positions are null, booleans stay boolean, and numeric cells are JSON numbers. rows remains the authoritative exact representation.
